edits.before: Q-farm and nothing else — your level 1 is among the worst mid. Give CS you can't Q safely and smile about it.
edits.after: His 1000-range Baleful Strike out-trades your melee start — farm what your 600-range Q reaches safely.

edits.before: Still surviving. Q on cooldown when free, pool saved for the jungler you haven't seen yet.
edits.after: Q-W poke chips you while he farms free AP stacks — Q on cooldown, pool held for ganks.

edits.before: E charges join the pattern: Q-E wave contact trades start mattering. Health is your mana — spend like an accountant.
edits.after: Event Horizon plus Dark Matter is a kill threat you cannot match yet — never stand on the cage line to trade.

edits.before: The crimson rush timing — Q empowers every third-ish cast and the sustain war starts tilting your way.
edits.after: Transfusion sustain now out-heals his mana-limited poke — the lane stabilises and you start walking forward.

edits.before: Hemoplague online — the all-in inverts: Q-E-R-E with ignite kills most mids who thought they were winning.
edits.after: Pool the cage edge or Primordial Burst and his all-in has no follow-up — then Hemoplague inverts the trade.

edits.before: Riftmaker timing: every trade heals more than it costs. Extended fights are now donations to your health bar.
edits.after: Riftmaker out-heals all his poke — he is immobile, so you walk him down whenever Event Horizon is down.

edits.before: Late Vlad is a raid boss: pool their engage, R their clump, and drain whatever stayed to argue.
edits.after: Late Vlad dives what Veigar cannot peel — pool the one cage, R the clump, drain whoever stays to argue.

edits.before: - Veigar Event Horizon (Cage): matchup-defining — Only the cage EDGE stuns — hold position near the center or leave before it forms; never dash into the wall. Check it before every step-up. - W Sanguine Pool is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: Event Horizon is 20s at rank 1 and only the EDGE stuns — hold near the center or leave before it forms. That 20 seconds is your walk-forward window: he is immobile without it. Primordial Burst is 120s early and scales off your missing health — pool the cast, never tank it low.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, E-charge as he steps to answer, release and walk — the trade costs him HP and pays yours.
edits.after: His E is 20s at rank 1 — once the cage and Dark Matter are spent, step in with Q-E and he has no answer left.

edits.before: Pooling his poke and then eating the real engage at half HP with nothing — the pool is a combo-breaker, not a flinch reflex.
edits.after: At half HP with W down, one cage clip means Dark Matter plus Primordial Burst — his R hits harder the lower you are.
